Villafuerte]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|National Unity Party (Philippines)}}|border=darkgray}} [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|NUP]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Camarines Sur's 5th congressional district''' is one of the [[Legislative districts of Camarines Sur|five congressional districts]] in the province of [[Camarines Sur]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 2010.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 15, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district was created following the 2009 [[reapportionment]] that split the [[Camarines Sur's 1st congressional district|1st district]] into two thereby creating an additional district for the province.{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 15, 2021}}{{cite web |url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2009/10/12/republic-act-no-9716/ |title=Republic Act No. 9716 |date=12 October 2009 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=February 15, 2021 |archive-date=16 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211016052856/https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2009/10/12/republic-act-no-9716/ |url-status=dead }} The district consists of the city of [[Iriga]] and adjacent municipalities in the [[Rinconada (region)|Rinconada]] region of southern Camarines Sur that previously comprised the [[Camarines Sur's 4th congressional district|4th district]], namely [[Baao, Camarines Sur|Baao]], [[Balatan, Camarines Sur|Balatan]], [[Bato, Camarines Sur|Bato]], [[Buhi, Camarines Sur|Buhi]], [[Bula, Camarines Sur|Bula]] and [[Nabua]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Miguel Luis Villafuerte]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 15, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
